key_features: Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity: Provides an efficient wireless connection between the smartwatch and compatible smartphones.
Bluetooth Calling: Make, receive and manage calls through the watch while it remains connected to a compatible smartphone.
Contact and Call History: Import supported contacts, view recent call records and enter numbers through the watch’s dialling interface.
Heart-Rate Monitoring: Measures real-time heart-rate information and stores supported historical data in the companion app.
Blood-Oxygen Measurement: Provides estimated SpO₂ readings for personal wellness reference.
Sleep and Activity Tracking: Records supported sleep information, daily steps, distance and estimated calorie consumption.
